author: mara
story: A company-wide assistant over the runbooks and hardware manuals. It retrieves passages with docs.search, lets the model look up a named charge point's status (read only), and returns the answer with the runbooks it used. Used here by the commercial team and by the platform admin, neither of whom is in Ops; every connector it uses is open to EDRI-All.

input.message: A site host in Milan says the charger shows a red light after rain. What does the runbook say to do?
How do I reset a charger after an RCD trip?
